audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven level-chart rows disagreed with the packet and with the content whys. win[1] said Skill while whys[1] says 'his ranged cannon stance dictates the lane and you just farm'; win[2] said K'Sante while whys[2] says he is 'owning the trade'; win[3] said K'Sante while whys[3] says 'the window is even'; win[4] said JAYCE while whys[4] describes K'Sante dashing through and peeling him out — the level-6 row was given to the wrong champion outright; win[5] said K'Sante while whys[5] says it 'comes down to whether his E is up'.
audit.why: Level 6 is the one row the page had backwards in the most damaging direction: All Out is K'Sante's swing window against a squishy hammer-stance Jayce, and the chart told the player to fear it. The packet chart and the mirror agree exactly.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 flipped to Jayce, rows 3 and 5 to Skill, and row 4 to K'Sante, each as a matched full/content pair with ratings adjusted and every why rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'unstoppable W' fabrication is worse on this page than anywhere else in my slice — six strings: whys[4] 'your unstoppable W eats his burst', whys[6] 'W unstoppable', spikes[3].text, early 'My W-charge is unstoppable', mid 'W-charge unstoppable straight through it', late 'W unstoppable means his E-knockback peel whiffs', wants.you[0] 'W-charge through it unstoppable'. Riot's text for Path Maker: K'Sante 'charges up, TAKING REDUCED DAMAGE, then dashes'. There is no unstoppable and no displacement immunity. Also 'Q3 knock-him-up' / 'knock him up and pull him in' — the second Ntofo stack is a shockwave that PULLS.
audit.why: This one inverts the whole lane plan. The page tells the player his W-charge makes Thundering Blow's knockback whiff, so he should charge straight into it. It does not — damage reduction does nothing against displacement, and Jayce's knockback will cancel the engage every time. The correct rule is the opposite: bait Thundering Blow out (20s at rank 1) and commit after.
audit.corrected: All six unstoppable claims replaced with the real damage reduction, and the advice re-pointed at baiting Thundering Blow first. The pull corrected in wants.you[0] and mid. Shock Blast's 16/14/12/10/8/6s and Thundering Blow's 20/18/16/14/12/10s written into tldr, winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and three chart rows.
sources: kit: K'Sante W 'charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes'
kit: Jayce Q 16/14/12/10/8/6, E 20/18/16/14/12/10 hammer knockback

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no numbers and a placeholder second line, and pointed only at Shock Blast.
audit.why: Thundering Blow is the cooldown that actually decides whether a commit works — 20s at rank 1 — and the page never mentioned it as a tracked window despite naming it in the don'ts. Shock Blast also has SIX ranks, so it drops to 6s much faster than a player used to five-rank abilities expects.
audit.corrected: Both written in by number, with the six-rank note.

edits.before: Jayce owns levels 1 through 3 outright — his Acceleration Gate empowered Q out-ranges everything I have, and with only Q online I can't walk it down to start my combo. Don't chase a single creep into his cannon-stance poke; soak the Q chip, last-hit at max Q range, and refuse to give him a free E-knockback into hammer burst. My W-charge is unstoppable but useless if I have no E or W yet, so I just farm and keep my HP healthy for the windows that come later.
edits.after: Jayce owns levels 1 through 3 outright — his Acceleration Gate empowered Q out-ranges everything I have, and with only Q online I can't walk it down to start my combo. Don't chase a single creep into his cannon-stance poke; soak the Q chip, last-hit at max Q range, and refuse to give him a free E-knockback into hammer burst. My W-charge only cuts the damage I take — it will not stop that knockback — so I just farm and keep my HP healthy for the windows later.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are even because I finally have my Q-W-E kit and can punish a greedy poke step: bait his E knockback, W-charge unstoppable straight through it, and Q3 to knock him up and pull him in. At 6 the lane swings to me — All Out converts my tank stats into a duelist profile and the W charge absorbs his cannon-Q-into-E burst, so I dash through, knock him back, and re-cast R to drag him out of his own poke spacing. The key is patience: only commit W when his E is on cooldown, because that knockback is the one tool that resets his safe distance.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are even because I finally have my Q-W-E kit and can punish a greedy poke step: bait his E knockback out first — it is 20s at rank 1 — then W-charge in and Q3 to pull him. At 6 the lane swings to me: All Out converts my tank stats into a duelist profile and the W charge cuts his cannon-Q-into-E burst, so I dash through, knock him back, and re-cast R to drag him out of his own poke spacing. The key is patience — the charge reduces damage, it does not make me unstoppable, so a live Thundering Blow still cancels the commit.

edits.before: This is where the EVEN matchup tips my way. A poke Jayce can't burst down a two-item control tank, and with Iceborn Gauntlet plus my passive move-speed stacking I close his kiting gap and stick on top of him. My R duelist window survives his full combo, and W unstoppable means his E-knockback peel whiffs the moment I commit. I just have to respect that his early lead can snowball his team — if he got fat off the lane, force the side-lane 1v1 where my sustained DPS and lockdown beat his single burst rotation rather than letting him poke a grouped fight.
edits.after: This is where the EVEN matchup tips my way. A poke Jayce can't burst down a two-item control tank, and with Iceborn Gauntlet plus my passive move-speed stacking I close his kiting gap and stick on top of him. My R duelist window survives his full combo, and once his 20s Thundering Blow is spent there is nothing left to reset his spacing. I just have to respect that his early lead can snowball his team — if he got fat off the lane, force the side-lane 1v1 where my sustained DPS and lockdown beat his single burst rotation rather than letting him poke a grouped fight.

notes: Worst page in my slice for the 'unstoppable W' fabrication — six separate strings tell the player Path Maker's charge makes him unstoppable and that Jayce's E-knockback 'whiffs' against it. Riot's text gives Path Maker reduced damage while charging, nothing more, so a live Thundering Blow cancels the engage every time. The page was therefore teaching the exact play that loses the lane: charge W into an available knockback. All six corrected and the advice re-pointed at baiting Thundering Blow (20s at rank 1) first. Five chart rows contradicted the packet and the whys, including Level 6 given to Jayce while whys[4] describes K'Sante winning it — flipped as matched pairs. The packet's suspectName on wants.foe[0] ('Land Acceleration Gate') is a FALSE POSITIVE: Acceleration Gate is Jayce's real cannon-stance E and the sentence is mechanically correct, since Shock Blast fired through the gate gains range and damage. No change made there.
